android_mechanism: OUI CSV import commits each row separately; fix batches all inserts into one transaction
bug_description: Clearing browsing history (settings -> clear history) walks every per-day history table, selects all row IDs and executes one standalone DELETE statement per row, each in its own implicit transaction (autocommit). With hundreds of history entries this causes hundreds of individual journal/fsync cycles, making the clear operation and the following UI freeze noticeably long.
fix_summary: All clear-history DELETE statements are wrapped in a single RDB transaction (beginTransaction/commit with rollback on error): one bulk DELETE per table inside one commit.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

mechanism_oracle.definition: Time from the clear-button tap event (input dispatch in trace) to completion of the last RDB write observed in disk activity.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed shows one sqlite fsync/journal cycle per deleted row; fixed shows a single commit. unfixed_clear_history_wall_time_ms > fixed_clear_history_wall_time_ms by >= 2x with 100+ entries.

reproduction: git -C hosts/browser checkout case/browser_history_delete_no_transaction/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/browser checkout case/browser_history_delete_no_transaction/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
